description: Labelled Slack conversations for the channel-watching classifier. `expected` is whether Tag should reply. Authors are roles: requester (the Tag's authorized owner, who sent `message`), tag, participant (another person; `participant:NAME` names them), and another_bot. `{tag}`, `{requester}` and `{participant}` in history text become Slack member mentions, so the real identity minimization runs. `message` never contains a member mention: those bypass the classifier. Labels follow the criteria in scripts/watch_classifier.py; `note` explains the hard ones.
